title: Review and local source-admission protocol
author: Faye Niu
purpose: Summarise the dissertation's bounded process for discovering, admitting, binding, verifying, retaining limitations in, and freezing locally reviewable literature evidence.

stage_traceability.name: Problem-led discovery
stage_traceability.decision: Generate candidates from the reporting problem, RQ1--RQ3 and explicit evidence gaps; classify intended source role before admission.

stage_traceability.name: Stable local full-text admission
stage_traceability.decision: Require readable local full text, or an immutable permitted capture, before claim use.

stage_traceability.name: Manifest, checksum and bibliography binding
stage_traceability.decision: Bind the citation key, bibliographic metadata, origin, local path, page count and SHA-256; bind web-capture metadata when used.

stage_traceability.name: Page-level claim verification
stage_traceability.decision: Inspect the local full text for the exact claim scope and retain the local page locator and source role.

stage_traceability.name: Contradiction and limitation retention
stage_traceability.decision: Keep conflicts, unknowns, source hierarchy, reconstruction limits and non-applicable fields attached to the synthesis decision.

stage_traceability.name: Strict freeze validation
stage_traceability.decision: Run the local validator and freeze cited files with their manifest, checksum, bibliography, capture and claim-locator bindings.

limitations: This is a purposive, problem-led, non-systematic and non-exhaustive review process; it is not PRISMA, a registered systematic review, a meta-analysis or a claim of database completeness.
Local access, hashing, manifest consistency, bibliography binding and citation presence establish internal traceability; they do not establish source truth.
The frozen local corpus can omit relevant material that is inaccessible, snippet-only, off-scope or unavailable as a stable permitted capture.
Page-level verification is claim-scoped and does not certify every statement in a source.
Source roles and evidence hierarchies remain distinct; admission does not make peer-reviewed work, preprints, guidance and vendor documentation equivalent.
The exhibit contains no mutable corpus count, empirical result, prevalence, effect size, production evidence or exhaustive-coverage claim.

self_hash_policy: The provenance file's own SHA-256 is reported externally because embedding it would create a self-referential hash.
